lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (n : ℕ) [inst_3 : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ E = n + 1)] (A : E →L[ℝ] E),
  (↑A).IsSymmetric →
    ∀ (x : ↑(Metric.sphere 0 1)),
      (MDiffAt fun y => 1 / 2 * inner ℝ (↑y) (A ↑y)) x ∧
        halfRayleighGradientExtension A ↑x ∈ (ℝ ∙ ↑x)ᗮ ∧
          ∀ (w : TangentSpace (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) x),
            ((d% fun y => 1 / 2 * inner ℝ (↑y) (A ↑y)) x) w =
              inner ℝ ((d% Subtype.val x) w) (halfRayleighGradientExtension A ↑x)
approved_definition_context: The function halfRayleighGradientExtension A is the ambient map y ↦ A y − ⟪y,A y⟫ y.

Metric.sphere 0 1 is the unit sphere; ↑x is the underlying ambient vector. The subtype ↥(ℝ ∙ ↑x)ᗮ consists of all vectors orthogonal to x. Inner products and norms are ambient real inner products and norms.

MDiffAt means genuine manifold differentiability. The d% expressions are manifold differentials, of the restricted function and of the inclusion Subtype.val respectively. The tangent chart space is the model of dimension n for a sphere in dimension n+1.
